references.text: Refers to the authority given to God's people, similar to the authority mentioned in Matthew 18:18.
Resembles the promise of binding and loosing given to Peter, reflecting the same authority given to the church in Matthew 18:18.
Speaks of authority over evil, parallel to the authority to bind and loose in Matthew 18:18.
The apostles' authority to forgive sins points back to the authority to bind and loose mentioned in Matthew 18:18.
